overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Reserve Edition 2-Person Full Spectrum Near Zero EMF FAR Infrared Sauna with Himalayan Salt Bar offers a premium wellness retreat right in your home. Designed for indoor use, this sauna combines the therapeutic benefits of 6 advanced heating elements, including PureTech™ Near Zero EMF FAR IR Carbon Panels, to promote muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. Crafted from natural Canadian Hemlock wood, it features an interior chromotherapy lighting system and red light therapy for enhanced relaxation. With its user-friendly touch screen control panel and integrated Bluetooth speakers, this sauna transforms any space, such as a basement or fitness room, into a personal sanctuary.
